recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait of a female vocalist with short blonde hair, set within a thin white-bordered frame against a dusty pink gradient background. The layout features elegant script text at the top and structured serif text at the bottom, evoking a mid-80s adult contemporary aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: Central portrait framed by a wide monochromatic border
Top-heavy script balanced by bottom-aligned serif blocks
Soft gradient background contrasting with the dark, high-contrast portrait
coreInvariants: Thin white internal border around the photo
Dusty rose to mauve vertical gradient
High-contrast studio lighting on the subject's face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered vertical rectangle containing a head-and-shoulders portrait, occupying approximately 40% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and smile within the central frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large script name at the top, drops to the central portrait, and settles on the album title at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial pink border area providing a clean, uncluttered frame for the central content.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-saturation background with high-value white text and high-contrast dark portrait tones.

letterConstructionRules: Top text uses a flowing, slanted formal script with high stroke contrast
Bottom text uses a clean, semi-bold serif with moderate x-height
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Calligraphic script for the artist name paired with a sturdy serif for the title to balance elegance with legibility.
graphicDevices: Thin white rectangular stroke framing the portrait

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the formal, high-contrast calligraphic feel of the top text.
Matches the traditional, structured serif look of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a square layout with a vertical gradient from light dusty rose at the top to a deeper mauve at the bottom. In the center, place a vertical rectangular portrait of a woman with short blonde hair against a black background, enclosed in a thin white line border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in a large white calligraphic script at the top. Add the album title in a medium-sized white bold serif font at the bottom, centered.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait centered and framed by a white line?
Is the background a soft pink/mauve gradient?
Is the top text a script font and the bottom text a serif font?

mustRedesign: Exact wording of the source text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script text is legible despite the flourishes.
Check that the white border around the photo is perfectly aligned.
Verify the gradient transition is smooth without banding.
Confirm the portrait lighting is dramatic with deep shadows.
recipe.reuseFormula: Square layout + Pink Gradient Background + Centered Framed Portrait + Top Script/Bottom Serif Typography.
